project.name: osgi/domains/worktree
project.description: The worktree domain: the worktree the seed cultivates, as ONE OSGi @Component that KNOWS its own git facts (root, HEAD provenance, working state). worktree-contract is the OSGi service interface (Worktree) scions @Reference, alongside the facts records (WorktreeFacts + WorktreeCoordinate + Provenance + WorkingState) the soil harvests into the cellar and consumers fetch back. worktree-core is the jgit-backed impl (JgitWorktree), jgit sealed behind it, exporting nothing. worktree-bdd is the worktree soil scenario.
